Package dayplanner

Class Input

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Input
public class Input extends Object

Console input helper backed by a Scanner.

Read methods display prompts and generally retry invalid input. The stream constructor also supports scripted input, such as a ByteArrayInputStream in a small example program, which is actually used in Tester for scripted input.

The goal of this class is to make user input as easy as possible to deal with in application classes. So, this class does a lot of the heavy lifting for you.

    • readBool

      public boolean readBool()

      Reads and returns a boolean from user input, prompting repeatedly until valid.

      Accepts responses beginning with Y/y or N/n; characters after the first non-space character do not affect the answer.

      Returns:
      User input as a boolean.

    • parseTime

      public static Time parseTime(String str)
      Parses a string representation of time in YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM format.
      Parameters:
      str - The string representing a time in YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM format.
      Returns:
      A valid Time, or null for empty or invalid input. For example, 2026/09/15 14:30 produces a time value.

    • readTime

      public Time readTime()
      Reads and returns a valid Time from user input, prompting repeatedly until valid.
      Returns:
      A valid Time; malformed values are explained and requested again.
